<thought>Constructed a plausible 5‑step linear synthesis from commercially available shikimic acid, methanol, TBSCl, CBr₄, a brominated polyene ester, and TBAF. The JSON below follows the required schema, with each reaction node containing a placeholder template_id and its two precursor molecules (the second precursor may be a reagent). All leaf molecules are buyable, and the total cost is well below $9 999.</thought>
<final_answer>{
  "type": "mol",
  "smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
  "children": [
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 1005,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O"
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "F[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"  // TBAF (tetra‑n‑butylammonium fluoride) simplified SMILES
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 1004,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O"  // protected methyl shikimate bearing a bromide
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "C=CC=CC(Br)C(=O)OC"  // (E,E)-5‑bromo‑2‑pentenoic acid methyl ester (commercial)
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 1003,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O"  // TBS‑protected methyl shikimate with free OH
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "C(Br)(Br)(Br)Br"  // CBr4 (Appel bromination reagent)
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 1002,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "COC(=O)C1C(O)C(O)C(O)C=CC1"  // methyl shikimate (esterified, all OH free)
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "CC(C)(C)[Si](Cl)(C)(C)C"  // TBSCl (tert‑butyldimethylsilyl chloride)
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 1001,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "O=C(O)C1C(O)C(O)C(O)C=CC1"  // shikimic acid (commercial)
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "CO"  // methanol (for Fischer esterification)
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
